## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
* Keep all styling strictly inside a dedicated `style.css` file.
* **No Inline CSS:** the `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML.
* **Class/ID Selectors Only:** all design properties, layout rules, and states must be targeted via class or ID selectors.
* **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML must remain clean, semantic, and agnostic of visual styling — changing the site's look must require editing only the CSS file, never the markup.

**1.2 CSS Variables (`var(--...)`) & Theme Tokens**
Store all visual tokens in `:root` (light) and `.dark` (dark). Mandatory tokens: `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success` — plus theme-specific `--primary-accent` (decorative emerald) and `--primary-soft` (emerald tint), and structural tokens: `--font-base`, `--radius-sm: 8px`, `--radius-md: 12px`, `--radius-lg: 24px`, `--shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)`, `--shadow-md`, `--spacing-gap`, `--transition-fast: 150ms`, `--transition-normal: 300ms`, `--ease-standard`, `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`.
* **Suggested light values (verify WCAG AA ≥ 4.5:1 for body text before finalizing):** `--primary: #047857` (CTAs, links), `--primary-accent: #10B981`, `--primary-soft: #ECFDF5`, `--secondary: #F5F5F4` (warm neutral), `--bg-secondary: #F7FAF9`, `--text-primary: #1A1A1A`, `--text-secondary: #4B5563`, `--text-success: #15803D`, `--text-error: #B91C1C`, `--border-default: #E5E7EB`, `--border-success: #10B981`, `--border-error: #DC2626`.
* **Suggested dark values:** green-tinted deep neutrals (`--bg-primary: #0C1210`, `--bg-secondary: #141C19`), light text (`--text-primary: #F3F7F5`), brightened emerald (`--primary: #34D399`, paired with dark text when used as a surface), adjusted borders and softened shadows.
* **Contrast Pairing:** every light background token must pair with a dark text token, and every dark background token with a light text token — enforce this in every theme, not just the default.
* **Light Mode Background:** do not default to pure white; where a white/near-white surface is needed, use `#fefefe` instead of `#ffffff`. **Exception (source spec):** the source CSS explicitly sets `background: #FFFFFF` — `--bg-primary` may therefore be `#FFFFFF` in light mode; all other near-white surfaces (cards, inputs, header) must still use `#fefefe` or tinted neutrals so elevation remains perceptible.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support**
* Dark mode must always be defined: dark tokens under both `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and a `.dark` class selector, so backgrounds and text swap seamlessly without HTML restructuring.
* **Persistence:** store the user's choice in `localStorage`, falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit; provide a visible toggle control (sun/moon Material icons) with correct `aria-pressed` and `aria-label` state.
* **Exception (source spec):** the source style specification requests a light-only experience ("Light: Full / Dark: No") — light mode must therefore be the default, primary art direction, but the dark mode implementation above is still mandatory and must be equally polished, not an afterthought.

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
* Build all layout structures with Flexbox (`display: flex` / Tailwind flex utilities).
* **Default Alignment Rule:** every flex container must default to `align-items: center` (`items-center`) unless an exception is explicitly justified in a CSS comment.
* **Mobile-Friendly First:** all flex layouts must be responsive out of the box (rows convert to columns on small viewports); prevent horizontal scrolling at every breakpoint from 320px up.

**1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration**
* Use Tailwind CSS (or clean custom CSS driven by Tailwind's `@layer` / `@apply`) unless another framework is requested.
* All utility classes must map back to CSS variables or generic reusable class names (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`, `.section`, `.container`).

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
* Include Inter via Google Fonts `<link>`/`@import`, bound to `--font-base`.
* Use Google Material Symbols for every icon; **raw inline SVG icons and local icon files are forbidden.**
* **Exception (source spec):** the source specification explicitly requests organic curve separators via SVG — decorative separator/background shapes may therefore be inline SVG paths (`aria-hidden="true"`, `focusable="false"`, presentational only); this exception never extends to functional icons.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**2.1 Button Component Requirements**
Style all states via CSS classes only:
* **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px. Variants: `.btn-primary` (emerald solid), `.btn-secondary` (outline), `.btn-ghost`, `.btn-danger` (visually distinct in both themes).
* **Hover:** brightness/shadow shift with `cursor: pointer`.
* **Focus:** distinct ring using CSS variables (`outline`/`box-shadow`) for keyboard navigation.
* **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)`.
* **Loading:** disables interactions, prevents double-clicks, renders a CSS spinner or animated Google icon without distorting button dimensions.
* **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`.
* **Success/Error:** temporary feedback styles driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error`.

**2.2 Card Component Requirements**
Used for Features (3), Testimonials (3), and Pricing (3):
* **Default:** flexible Flexbox layout, `--bg-secondary`/`#fefefe` surface, `--border-default`, `--radius-md`/`--radius-lg`, `--shadow-sm`.
* **Hover:** subtle elevation shift — `transform: translateY(-2px)` plus `--shadow-md` (keep motion gentle; this brand is "trustworthy," not flashy).
* **Focus-within:** card border highlights when a child link/button receives focus.
* **Loading (Skeleton):** define shimmer animation classes in CSS to prevent layout jumps.
* **Empty State:** structured fallback layout with a Google icon and clear guidance text.

**2.3 Form & Input Requirements**
Applies to the Final CTA email-capture form (and any demo/contact form):
* **States:** Empty, Focused (signature green border + green ring shadow), Filled, Valid (success border + check icon), Invalid (error border, red text, error icon), Disabled, Read-only.
* **Structure:** `.input-group` Flex container wrapping a `<label>`, the input, and a dedicated error-feedback container.
* **Behavior:** client-side validation with per-field, inline messages announced via an `aria-live` region; submit shows a loading state, then a visible success confirmation.

**2.4 Accordion (FAQ) & Modal / Popup Requirements**
* **FAQ Accordion:** each item is a `<button>` (`aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`) plus a panel (`role="region"`, `aria-labelledby`); collapsed/expanded states animated via CSS (`grid-template-rows` or `max-height` technique); chevron Material icon rotates; fully keyboard operable.
* **Modal (only if one is included, e.g., a demo/video dialog):** Opening, Open, Loading, Success/Error, and Closing states all animated via CSS transitions; centered flex container (`align-items: center`); backdrop overlay; Google icon close button; keyboard focus trapping; close via `Esc` or overlay click; layered with `--z-modal`.

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

* **Responsive by Default:** fluid sizing, no horizontal overflow; `scroll-margin-top` on anchored sections to compensate for the sticky header.
* **Smooth Animations:** `transition: var(--transition-normal)` on all state changes; **respect `prefers-reduced-motion`** — disable the heartbeat pulse, transforms, and smooth scrolling; keep content fully visible and static.
* **Accessibility (a11y):** WCAG AA contrast in both light and dark modes; never rely solely on color to communicate state (pair icons/text with color); semantic HTML5 (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `footer`); a skip-to-content link; correct ARIA roles/labels on custom widgets; logical DOM/focus order; full keyboard operability; `aria-live` regions for form errors, confirmations, and loading states; visible focus indicators everywhere.
* **Mandatory Visual Feedback:** every click, hover, or submission triggers a visible state change (nav link hover/active underline, button states, accordion expansion, form validation, submit success).
* **Destructive Actions:** `.btn-danger` must be visually distinct in both light and dark themes.
* **Sticky Header:** gains a shadow/solid background on scroll; anchor navigation uses smooth scrolling (reduced-motion aware).
* **Optional scroll-reveal:** gentle fade-up on section entry via IntersectionObserver adding an `.is-visible` class — disabled under reduced motion, and all content must be visible without JavaScript.

## 4. DELIVERABLE & OUTPUT FORMAT

* **File Structure:** separate `index.html`, `style.css`, and `script.js` files. No inline `<script>` blocks beyond a single deferred entry-point reference (`<script src="script.js" defer>`). No inline styles anywhere.
* **Naming Convention:** BEM for all custom component classes (`.card`, `.card__title`, `.card--featured`); Tailwind utilities restricted to layout/spacing only; never mix conventions. All colors, radii, and shadows must resolve to CSS variables.
* **Copy:** write **all user-facing copy in English** (the source specification was Portuguese — translate every concept; do not output Portuguese text). Produce realistic, specific HealthTech marketing copy: named testimonials with roles, concrete pricing features, and genuinely answered FAQ questions. **No lorem ipsum.** Placeholders are permitted only where content was genuinely left unspecified.
* **Definition of Done (self-check before submitting):** zero `style="..."` attributes; zero inline script bodies; all mandatory tokens defined in `:root` and `.dark`; theme toggle persists via `localStorage` with correct ARIA state; all Section 2 states implemented; heartbeat animation and organic separators present (static under reduced motion); full keyboard-only pass succeeds; no horizontal scroll from 320px to desktop; all copy in English; all sections in Section 5 present.
